zh-CN.title: 回声唱片铺的专辑收藏
items: 奖池按金、铂、钻、曜分栏，圆形光盘每行两张，各有对应的盘缘和徽记。
点击活动人物封套进入对应的奖励，查看气泡、浏览专辑或装备已解锁的气泡。

en.title: Album Collecting at Echo Record Shop
items: Browse two columns of album discs across Gold, Platinum, Diamond and Obsidian tabs with distinct rims and emblems.
Open an artist sleeve to preview the bubble, browse albums, or equip an unlocked bubble.
